name: LOVM
description: LOVM is a benchmark and task for evaluating vision-language models' zero-shot performance on downstream applications by selecting and predicting model performance based solely on textual descriptions of the tasks, without access to labeled datasets.
reputation: A niche benchmark with some research use for evaluating zero-shot model selection, but not a widely adopted standard benchmark.
notes: Enables efficient model selection without labeled datasets by leveraging text descriptions; includes evaluations of 35 VLMs on 23 datasets.
